decisions.because: Round-9 control hunt (2026-10-15): a ban, a local decision, a peer claim and a BlockSync claim each checked the policy before the table lock; one waiting through a host refresh added a newly protected address after the recheck (an operator ban held it indefinitely). All three race tests failed on their assertion before the fix; BlockSync also alone.

statement: Every path that adds or adopts a block (operator ban, local decision, peer claim, BlockSync) reads the never-block policy under the block table's lock, where the host refresh replaces it and rechecks the table: a decision that waited through a refresh does not enforce an address the refresh protected.
